quarterly_data.quarter: POSCO press release: POSCO HOLDINGS Completes Upstream Process of Second Brine (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: POSCO HOLDINGS completed the upstream process of its second brine lithium plant near the Hombre Muerto salt lake in Argentina (4,000 meters above sea level; completion ceremony October 6 local time), eight years after acquiring the mining lease in 2018. The Plant 2 upstream facility, completed with a total investment of $954 million, has an annual production capacity of 23,000 tons of lithium carbonate; with Plant 1's existing 25,000 tons (completed in 2024, when commercial production began), total commercial production capacity in Argentina is now 48,000 tons. The company will work to bring Plant 2 to normal operation at an early date.
quarterly_data.figure: Plant 2: 23,000 tons lithium carbonate per year, $954 million total investment; Argentina total 48,000 tons (Plant 1 25,000 tons)

quarterly_data.quarter: POSCO press release: POSCO HOLDINGS Completes Upstream Process of Second Brine (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lithium targets: the lithium carbonate from the Plant 2 upstream facility is to be converted into 25,000 tons of battery-grade lithium hydroxide per year by the downstream process at the Yulchon Industrial Complex (Jeollanam-do), scheduled for completion in 2027, completing a brine-based lithium hydroxide production system with a total capacity of 50,000 tons. POSCO HOLDINGS will accelerate new investments in Plants 3 and 4 (each 25,000 tons of lithium carbonate per year) to complete a 100,000-ton brine lithium production system by 2033, to respond to energy storage system (ESS) market growth driven by the expansion of AI data centers and rising demand for LFP batteries; on the ceremony day POSCO-Argentina signed an MOU with the Salta and Catamarca provincial governments for administrative support and permits for Plants 3 and 4. CEO Chang In Hwa: 'We will continue to proactively secure competitive resources, turn them into production and profit, and ensure a stable supply of the critical minerals essential to the nation's industries.'
quarterly_data.figure: Yulchon downstream 25,000 tons lithium hydroxide per year, completion scheduled in 2027 (50,000 tons system); Plants 3 and 4 25,000 tons each; 100,000-ton brine lithium system by 2033
